blocks.text: Mending has survived more clearly than the explanations once attached to it. Threadshell compresses the idea of holding a damaged pattern together into a small shell and one releasable knot; its everyday name describes what an Era Four caretaker can hold.
An impossible folded ivory ceramic spool, asymmetrical crescent jaws holding a suspended copper thread knot, tiny teal seams, ancient repaired domestic artifact.
One-shot use: The copper binding unwinds from the crescent and gathers into a large released coil in its opening. The game performs the final fade.
50 silver. Clears Injury / Chronic. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
